SchemaVersion.title: DescriptorSchemaVersion
SchemaVersion.description: Descriptor schema semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Minor versions only add optional fields. Major versions break. This schema accepts 1.0.x.

RobotId.title: DescriptorRobotId
RobotId.description: Stable robot identifier. The same spelling as telemetry robot_id.

DisplayName.title: DescriptorDisplayName
DisplayName.description: Non-empty model name without leading or trailing whitespace.

NameToken.title: DescriptorNameToken
NameToken.description: Joint, arm, camera, or frame name.

ResourceUrl.title: DescriptorResourceUrl
ResourceUrl.description: package:// or http(s) URL of the robot URDF or xacro. Not a licence to load arbitrary files.

TelemetrySchemaId.title: DescriptorTelemetrySchemaId
TelemetrySchemaId.description: Telemetry contract this robot's samples use. ohho.telemetry.v1.

Radians.title: DescriptorRadians
Radians.description: Angle in radians, right-hand rule. Not degrees.

TagSizeMetres.title: DescriptorTagSizeMetres
TagSizeMetres.description: Printed AprilTag side length in metres. Must be greater than 0.

DriveKind.title: DescriptorDriveKind
DriveKind.description: Base drive kind. fixed-base means the base must not be commanded.

CameraKind.title: CameraKind
CameraKind.description: Camera stream kind. rgb is a colour image. depth is a depth image. bev is a stitched bird's-eye image.

DescriptorKind.title: DescriptorKind
DescriptorKind.description: sim is a simulator. real is a physical robot. This is the telemetry sample kind, not a motion permit.

TelemetryBlock.title: TelemetryBlock
TelemetryBlock.description: Optional ohho.telemetry.v1 block this robot can emit. Omitting a block here means samples omit it. It does not clear an e-stop.

DriveCaps.title: DriveCaps
DriveCaps.description: Advertised drive speeds. These must not exceed safety.hard. Linear caps are metres per second. Yaw is radians per second. Maximums are the OmniBot ceilings (0.2 m/s, 1.0 rad/s) and must not be raised. A tighter producer clamp stays in force.

vx_mps.description: Maximum forward speed in metres per second. Ceiling 0.2.

vy_mps.description: Maximum lateral speed in metres per second. Ceiling 0.2. Zero when the drive cannot strafe.

wz_rad_s.description: Maximum yaw rate in radians per second. Ceiling 1.0.

DescriptorDrive.title: DescriptorDrive
DescriptorDrive.description: Base drive. holonomic true means the base can strafe. It is not a motion permit.

holonomic.description: True when the base can translate in the plane without a non-holonomic constraint.

DescriptorJoint.title: DescriptorJoint
DescriptorJoint.description: One revolute joint. min, max, and home are radians. They describe the producer limit and are not a licence to widen it.

DescriptorArm.title: DescriptorArm
DescriptorArm.description: One arm. joints are in command order. An empty arms array means the robot has no arm.

joints.description: Revolute joints in command order. At least one.

DescriptorTopics.title: DescriptorTopics
DescriptorTopics.description: Topics a console should use instead of hard-coded names. cmd is the base command. state is odometry. estop is the e-stop latch. heartbeat and telemetry are the ohho.telemetry.v1 streams. images lists camera topics.

images.description: Image topics. Every camera.topic must appear here.

DescriptorCamera.title: DescriptorCamera
DescriptorCamera.description: One camera. topic is the image stream. frame is the optical or camera frame.

AprilTag.title: AprilTag
AprilTag.description: One AprilTag fixed to the robot. T_tag_base takes the tag frame into the base frame.

T_tag_base.description: Row-major 4x4 homogeneous transform from the tag frame to the base frame. Translation is metres. Sixteen finite numbers.

DescriptorTelemetry.title: DescriptorTelemetry
DescriptorTelemetry.description: Which ohho.telemetry.v1 sample this robot emits. kind is sim or real. fields lists blocks the robot can populate. A schema-valid descriptor is not permission to skip the producer safety gate.

fields.description: Telemetry blocks this robot can emit, in sample order.

HardSafetyCaps.title: HardSafetyCaps
HardSafetyCaps.description: Hard safety caps. A consumer must not command above these. Maximums are the OmniBot ceilings: 0.2 m/s linear, 1.0 rad/s yaw, 0.5 m/s^2 linear acceleration, 2.0 rad/s^2 yaw acceleration, 0.15 rad joint step. Do not raise them. A tighter clamp in the driver or safety gate stays in force. This object is not a motion permit.

max_vx_mps.description: Hard cap on forward speed in metres per second. Ceiling 0.2.

max_vy_mps.description: Hard cap on lateral speed in metres per second. Ceiling 0.2.

max_wz_rad_s.description: Hard cap on yaw rate in radians per second. Ceiling 1.0.

max_accel_x_mps2.description: Hard cap on forward acceleration in metres per second squared. Ceiling 0.5.

max_accel_y_mps2.description: Hard cap on lateral acceleration in metres per second squared. Ceiling 0.5.

max_accel_wz_rad_s2.description: Hard cap on yaw acceleration in radians per second squared. Ceiling 2.0.

max_joint_step_rad.description: Hard cap on joint-target change per accepted command, in radians. Ceiling 0.15.

DescriptorSafety.title: DescriptorSafety
DescriptorSafety.description: Safety block. hard is required. Missing hard caps are invalid and must not be treated as unlimited.
